text: VPN and network connectivity troubleshooting. Check the VPN router model and firmware version, review recent network configuration changes, verify DNS and routing tables, collect client logs with timestamps and error messages for Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, repeater and switch issues. If several users or sites are affected, escalate to the network team as an incident.

Security incident and data breach response. Isolate affected systems immediately, preserve logs and alerts, notify the security team, verify compliance requirements such as HIPAA, GDPR and ISO 27001, check for unauthorized access, and document containment and recovery actions. Never share credentials or patient data over unencrypted channels.

Hardware and device troubleshooting for printers, headsets, scanners, SSD, NAS, projectors and audio devices. Confirm exact device model, operating system version, driver and firmware version, test a different cable or port, check Device Manager detection, and collect error messages. Escalate to on-site support if hardware replacement is required.

title_zh: 云平台与 SaaS 故障排查
text: Cloud platform and SaaS incident handling. Check Kubernetes pods, microservices orchestration, CI/CD pipeline deployments, API gateways, integration endpoints and data lake synchronization. Collect deployment logs, service timestamps and error messages, confirm which features or dashboards are degraded, and escalate to the infrastructure team when restarts do not restore service.

Software bug and performance investigation. Reproduce the issue, record the exact steps, browser and operating system version, capture crash logs and screenshots, check recent updates, patches and compatibility with the latest release. If performance degradation is intermittent, collect timestamps and response time measurements before escalating to engineering.

Account and access management. Verify login credentials, authentication tokens, license validity, password reset status, subscription state and multi-factor authentication. Ask for the affected account ID and the exact error message. Never ask the customer to send a full password. Escalate locked or compromised accounts to the identity team.

Billing and payment disputes. Request the invoice number, billing period, charged amount, payment method and transaction dates. Check for duplicate charges, subscription tier changes, refund eligibility, late payment fees and currency conversion issues. Provide a clear breakdown of charges and the expected correction timeline.

Returns and exchanges procedure. Confirm the order number, product model, purchase date and original packaging condition. Returns are normally accepted within 30 days with a receipt. Explain the return portal steps, shipping responsibility, warranty coverage and the expected refund or exchange processing time.

Product feature and documentation requests. Clarify the product model, integration target and intended use case, then provide the relevant manual, specification, API documentation, SDK guide or training material. If the requested feature is not supported, record the requirement as feedback and suggest a supported alternative.

Sales and pre-sales inquiries. Collect the organisation size, industry, budget range, required services and preferred timeline. Share pricing tiers, package options, case studies and onboarding information. Route qualified leads to the account team and record campaign or investment related questions for follow-up.

Human resources and organisation record updates. Verify the requester identity, department, employee role, effective date and the official document supporting the change. Update organisational charts, collaboration tooling access and contact lists only after approval, and keep an audit record of who requested and who approved the modification.

Incident response, outage and recovery workflow. Record the start time, affected services, number of impacted users, severity and recent changes. Apply standard containment and recovery steps, escalate to the on-call engineer when service is unavailable, communicate status updates on a fixed cadence, and document root cause and preventive actions after resolution.
